mainEntity.name: Can I compare new and used vehicles in one visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Motor Inn carries new new Toyota vehicles and available pre-owned inventory.

mainEntity.name: What should I bring if I am shopping or trading?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bring your driver's license, insurance information, current vehicle details, payoff information if applicable, and any must-have features or payment range you already have in mind.
